$comment: Presets. Members are derived: every bot with a verified token and one of the group's purposes, plus include, minus exclude (tokens, case-insensitive). order lists members in display order; members it doesn't list follow, sorted by token. Timpibot is excluded from search_engines: its purpose is documented, but it isn't one of the major search engines this preset stands for (verified.json inPresets: false).

groups.label: Search engines
groups.description: Google, Bing, Apple, DuckDuckGo, Yandex, Baidu and Huawei Petal Search. Blocking them removes pages from search results.

groups.label: AI training
groups.description: Crawlers whose operators say they collect pages to train AI models (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, Amazonbot…). Blocking them doesn't affect search.

groups.label: AI search and assistants
groups.description: AI answer engines and assistants that fetch pages to answer questions and cite them (ChatGPT search, Perplexity, Claude…). Their operators say they don't train on them.

groups.label: SEO tools
groups.description: Backlink and site-audit crawlers (Ahrefs, Semrush, Majestic, Moz…). They don't send visitors.
